mechanism: One fixed actual receiver-surface point transfers full attenuated native HIP motion into a rigid optical-roll/depth pair. This is a retargeting approximation, not source-recovered3D or a new authored directional clip.
selection: First actual weapon-surface hit from immutable aimed camera pixel(640,525); frozen for every direction/frame/gain.
protected: Original HIP/ADS Actions, key/handle shapes, normalized phase ordering, source camera, geometry, rest, weights, base/aim endpoints, and hand attachment controls. Playback rate is explicitly changed by17/20 for this diagnostic.
secondary_gates: Sight center/aperture clearance; wrist solve/guard; side contours and cadence; no reference score from the fitted receiver witness.
preset: single shared policy, frozen before rendering
vertical_gain_formula: .4*(1-.5*lateral_direction_weight); pure forward/back weight0; pure left/right weight1; interpolation for diagonals is proposed, not tested here.
raw_render_schedule: 60Hz output timeline, every third output frame(20Hz) plus integer frames near joins and exact worst-pose witnesses
retiming_limit: One constant phase-rate for every direction; native-time baseline remains in v3. No per-frame timewarp or candidate-specific registration.
application: Shared rigid transform of complete evaluated aim assembly; no root-only IK replay.
max_claim: Diagnostic only; no reference-match score and no production integration.
change_scope: Metadata clarification only; no preset parameter, rendered pose, trace, or trajectory changed.
